payload.text: Rarely ___ such a compelling case been made for radical reform.
payload.explanation_uz: Rarely inversiyani talab qiladi: yordamchi fe'l ega oldidan keladi (Rarely has a case been made).

payload.text: ___ it not for her timely intervention, the merger would have collapsed.
payload.explanation_uz: Rasmiy inversiyali shart: 'Were it not for...' = 'If it were not for...'.

payload.text: He double-checked every figure lest he ___ a mistake.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Lest' dan keyin 'should + fe'l' yoki subjunktiv (fe'lning oddiy shakli) ishlatiladi.

payload.text: The plan was approved, ___ with considerable reluctance.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Albeit' (= although it was) qisqartirilgan to'siqsiz gap hosil qiladi.

payload.text: The company runs a scheme ___ employees may purchase shares at a discount.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Whereby' = 'by which', rasmiy nutqda tizim yoki kelishuvni izohlaydi.

payload.text: So absorbed ___ in his work that he forgot lunch entirely.
payload.explanation_uz: 'So + sifat' gap boshida kelganda inversiya bo'ladi: So absorbed was he...

payload.text: Had I known about the risks, I ___ never have signed the contract.
payload.explanation_uz: Uchinchi tur shart gapining inversiyasi: Had I known..., I would have + V3.

payload.text: It is imperative that every applicant ___ the form by Friday.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Imperative that' dan keyin subjunktiv: ega har qanday shaxsda ham fe'l o'zak shaklida (submit).

payload.text: Under no circumstances ___ the doors be left unlocked overnight.
payload.explanation_uz: Salbiy qayd bilan boshlangan gapda inversiya bo'ladi: Under no circumstances should/must...

payload.text: Little ___ she suspect that the letter would change her life.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Little' (= umuman emas) gap boshida kelsa, yordamchi fe'l bilan inversiya bo'ladi.

payload.text: By next June the committee ___ (sit) for three years.
payload.explanation_uz: Kelasi vaqtgacha davom etgan jarayon uchun Future Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.

payload.text: I'd rather you ___ mention this to anyone just yet.
payload.explanation_uz: 'I'd rather + ega' dan keyin Past Simple ishlatiladi, ma'nosi hozirgi/kelasi zamon.

payload.text: Try ___ he might, he could not open the jar.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Try as he might' = 'harchand urinmasin', 'as' orqali kelgan to'siqsiz konstruksiya.

payload.text: Be that as it ___, we must proceed with the plan.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Be that as it may' qotib qolgan subjunktiv ibora (= shunday bo'lsa ham).

payload.text: The more she thought about it, ___ she disliked the idea.
payload.explanation_uz: Qiyosiy korrelyativ konstruksiya: the + qiyosiy daraja ..., the + qiyosiy daraja.

payload.text: She is believed ___ destroyed the manuscript before fleeing the country.
payload.explanation_uz: Passiv taxminiy konstruksiya: is believed + to have + V3 (oldingi harakat uchun).

payload.text: I didn't want to attend the ceremony, but I felt I ought ___.
payload.explanation_uz: Ellipsis: 'ought' dan keyin takrorlanayotgan fe'l tushiriladi, faqat 'to' qoladi.

payload.text: If you are asked to speak, please do ___.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Do so' oldingi fe'l iborasining o'rnini bosuvchi (substitution) rasmiy shakl.

payload.text: Scarcely ___ the meeting begun when the fire alarm sounded.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Scarcely/Hardly' bilan Past Perfect inversiyasi: Scarcely had + ega + V3 ... when.

payload.text: Such ___ the force of the explosion that windows shattered a mile away.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Such' gap boshida kelganda 'to be' fe'li egadan oldin keladi: Such was the force...

payload.text: No sooner had she sat down ___ the phone rang.
payload.explanation_uz: 'No sooner' faqat 'than' bilan keladi (Hardly/Scarcely esa 'when' bilan).

payload.text: Should you ___ further assistance, do not hesitate to contact us.
payload.explanation_uz: Rasmiy inversiyali shart: Should you + fe'l = If you should...

payload.text: Were he ___ resign, the party would be thrown into turmoil.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Were + ega + to + V' kam ehtimolli yoki farazli shartni bildiradi.

payload.text: It was not until 1990 ___ the law was finally repealed.
payload.explanation_uz: Ajratuvchi (cleft) gap: It was not until ... that ...

payload.text: Only by sustained effort ___ the team overcome the deficit.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Only + ravish iborasi' gap boshida kelsa, inversiya bo'ladi (did the team overcome).

payload.text: He talks as if he ___ the owner of the place.
payload.explanation_uz: 'As if' dan keyin nomaqbul holatda subjunktiv 'were' (norasmiy 'was' ham mumkin).

payload.text: The results, few of ___ were surprising, were published in March.
payload.explanation_uz: Miqdor so'zi + of + which: nisbiy gapda predlogli nisbiy olmosh ishlatiladi.

payload.text: Not only ___ the deadline missed, but the budget was also exceeded.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Not only' gap boshida kelganda inversiya bo'ladi: Not only was the deadline missed...

payload.question: She felt deeply ___ about leaving, torn between duty and desire.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Ambivalent' ichki qarama-qarshi tuyg'ularni bildiradi; 'ambiguous/equivocal' gap yoki bayonotga tegishli.

payload.question: The tribunal's ruling set a ___ for all future cases.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Precedent' = namuna bo'ladigan oldingi qaror; 'precedence' esa ustuvorlik.

payload.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: Having been told twice, the instructions still confused him.
Hardly she had left when the phone rang.
Were I to be offered the post, I would of accepted it.
Had the warnings been heeded, the disaster might have been averted.
payload.explanation_uz: Inversiyali uchinchi tur shart to'g'ri; boshqalarida osilib qolgan sifatdosh, noto'g'ri tartib va 'would of' xatolari bor.

payload.question: Which verb is most appropriate in a formal academic register? 'The new data ___ the original hypothesis.'
payload.explanation_uz: 'Corroborate' akademik uslubdagi rasmiy fe'l (= tasdiqlamoq); qolganlari so'zlashuv uslubida.

payload.question: She decided to ___ a formal complaint with the regulator.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Lodge a complaint' barqaror kollokatsiya (= rasman shikoyat topshirmoq).

payload.question: The negotiations were ___ with difficulty from the very start.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Fraught with' = (qiyinchilik, xavf) bilan to'la; barqaror kollokatsiya.

payload.question: If I ___ harder at school, I would be in a better job now.
payload.explanation_uz: Aralash shart: o'tmishdagi sabab (had worked) + hozirgi natija (would be).

payload.question: The scheme was costly; ___, it proved remarkably effective.
payload.explanation_uz: Qarama-qarshilikni bildiruvchi bog'lovchi so'z 'Nevertheless' (= shunga qaramay).

payload.question: Some critics praised the film; ___ dismissed it as derivative.
payload.explanation_uz: Ko'plik 'some ... others' juftligi qismlarni qarama-qarshi qo'yadi.

payload.question: The board demanded that the CEO ___ down immediately.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Demand that' dan keyin subjunktiv: fe'l o'zak shaklida (step).

payload.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Not only did the scheme fail, but it also bankrupted the council.
Not only the scheme failed, but it also bankrupted the council.
Not only failed the scheme, but it also bankrupted the council.
Not only did fail the scheme, but it also bankrupted the council.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Not only' dan keyin yordamchi fe'l ega oldidan keladi, asosiy fe'l o'zak shaklida egadan keyin.

payload.question: The judge was known for her ___ wit; she never wasted a word.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Laconic' = kam so'zli, lo'nda; boshqa variantlar ko'p gapirishni bildiradi.

payload.question: By the time you read this letter, I ___ Tashkent.
payload.explanation_uz: Kelajakdagi ma'lum paytgacha tugagan harakat uchun Future Perfect ishlatiladi.

payload.question: Complete the sentence: 'Attached ___ the documents you requested.'
payload.explanation_uz: Fronting: fe'l (are) ko'plik ega 'the documents' bilan moslashadi.

payload.question: The manager told him to stop ___ and answer the question directly.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Beat about the bush' = to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob bermay aylanib yurmoq.

payload.question: ___ the evidence, the jury acquitted him unanimously.
payload.explanation_uz: Sifatdosh egasi (the jury) fe'l bajaruvchisi bo'lgani uchun aktiv 'Having weighed' kerak.

payload.question: He is by no means averse ___ a challenge.
payload.explanation_uz: 'Averse to' barqaror kollokatsiya (= qarshi emas); 'to' predlogi ishlatiladi.
